Performers
Makemi (solo voice) Documented

The creator says performed live by self. The original’s embedded author tag reads Magdalen Kadel; the public credit retains the explicitly licensed username rather than expanding the performer’s name from an embedded tag alone.

[1] [2]
Work version
Monophonic Marian antiphon, performed by a solo singer Documented

The Hildegard Society identifies the antiphon in the Dendermonde manuscript, not Ordo virtutum. The recording pages’ dramatic attribution and associated circa-1151 date are rejected. The performer’s edition is unknown.

[3] [1] [2]
Recorded
2006 Documented

The edited file’s description states 2006 and live performance. The original was uploaded on 23 March 2006; that day is not promoted to a session date. The derivative was uploaded on 1 October 2008.

Transfer
Original performance upload by Makemi; applause-removed derivative uploaded by Adam Cuerden Documented

These are uploader and derivative-provenance credits. A separately named recording engineer is not established.

[1] [2]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

The 2008 derivative upload dates the deposited file, not necessarily the editing operation. No separate mastering date is known.

[1] [2]
Processing
Applause at the end removed from O frondens.ogg; Ogg Vorbis derivative and Wikimedia MP3 transcode Documented

The source explicitly describes this non-musical trim. The derivative names Xiph.Org libVorbis I 20040629. No other restoration, tuning correction or musical edit is established.

[1] [2]
Composition rights
Public-domain medieval composition Documented

The Commons Composition block applies public-domain status to Hildegard’s work. It does not license the modern sound recording.

[1] [3]
Recording rights
Rule 1 — CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported, performer’s release Documented

The separately headed Performance block names Makemi as copyright holder and grants CC BY-SA 3.0 through GFDL migration; the original creator upload supplies the same licensing chain. audio.mjs selects the composition’s Public domain tag, so that automatic result is not used as recording clearance.

[1] [2] [4]

Hildegard of Bingen, O frondens virga, Marian antiphon; performed live by Makemi, 2006. Original recording released by Makemi; applause-removed derivative uploaded by Adam Cuerden, Wikimedia Commons. CC BY-SA 3.0. No additional audio edit by Contrapunctus. Rights statement
